verses.original: γὰρ Οὗτος ὁ Μελχισέδεκ βασιλεὺς Σαλήμ ἱερεὺς τοῦ Θεοῦ τοῦ Ὑψίστου ὁ συναντήσας Ἀβραὰμ ὑποστρέφοντι ἀπὸ τῆς κοπῆς τῶν βασιλέων καὶ εὐλογήσας αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: gar Houtos ho Melchisedek basileus Salēm hiereus tou Theou tou Hypsistou ho synantēsas Abraam hypostrephonti apo tēs kopēs tōn basileōn kai eulogēsas auton
verses.literal: - This - Melchizedek [was] king of Salem [and] priest - of God - Most High - He met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him

verses.original: καὶ Ἀβραάμ ἐμέρισεν ᾧ δεκάτην ἀπὸ πάντων πρῶτον μὲν ἑρμηνευόμενος Βασιλεὺς δικαιοσύνης δὲ ἔπειτα καὶ Βασιλεὺς Σαλήμ ὅ ἐστιν Βασιλεὺς εἰρήνης
verses.transliteration: kai Abraam emerisen hō dekatēn apo pantōn prōton men hermēneuomenos Basileus dikaiosynēs de epeita kai Basileus Salēm ho estin Basileus eirēnēs
verses.literal: and Abraham apportioned to [him] a tenth of everything First [his name] means king of righteousness - Then also king of Salem - means king of peace

verses.original: ἀπάτωρ ἀμήτωρ ἀγενεαλόγητος ἔχων μήτε ἀρχὴν ἡμερῶν μήτε τέλος ζωῆς δὲ ἀφωμοιωμένος τῷ Υἱῷ τοῦ Θεοῦ μένει ἱερεὺς εἰς τὸ διηνεκές
verses.transliteration: apatōr amētōr agenealogētos echōn mēte archēn hēmerōn mēte telos zōēs de aphōmoiōmenos tō Huiō tou Theou menei hiereus eis to diēnekes
verses.literal: Without father [or] mother [or] genealogy without . . . beginning of days [or] end of life - like the Son - of God he remains a priest for - all time

verses.original: δὲ Θεωρεῖτε πηλίκος οὗτος καὶ ὁ πατριάρχης Ἀβραὰμ ἔδωκεν ᾧ δεκάτην ἐκ τῶν ἀκροθινίων
verses.transliteration: de Theōreite pēlikos houtos kai ho patriarchēs Abraam edōken hō dekatēn ek tōn akrothiniōn
verses.literal: - Consider how great [Melchizedek was] Even the patriarch Abraham gave [him] a tenth of the plunder

verses.original: καὶ μὲν κατὰ τὸν νόμον ἔχουσιν ἐντολὴν οἱ ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Λευὶ λαμβάνοντες τὴν ἱερατείαν ἀποδεκατοῦν τὸν λαὸν τοῦτ’ ἔστιν τοὺς αὐτῶν ἀδελφοὺς καίπερ ἐξεληλυθότας ἐκ τῆς ὀσφύος Ἀβραάμ
verses.transliteration: kai men kata ton nomon echousin entolēn hoi ek tōn huiōn Leui lambanontes tēn hierateian apodekatoun ton laon tout’ estin tous autōn adelphous kaiper exelēlythotas ek tēs osphyos Abraam
verses.literal: Now . . . - the law vvv commands the vvv vvv sons of Levi who become - priests to collect a tenth from the people that is from their brothers though they [too] are descended from . . . . . . Abraham

verses.original: δὲ ὁ μὴ γενεαλογούμενος ἐξ αὐτῶν δεδεκάτωκεν Ἀβραάμ καὶ εὐλόγηκεν τὸν ἔχοντα τὰς ἐπαγγελίας
verses.transliteration: de ho mē genealogoumenos ex autōn dedekatōken Abraam kai eulogēken ton echonta tas epangelias
verses.literal: But [Melchizedek] vvv who did not trace his descent from [Levi] collected a tenth from Abraham and blessed him who had the promises

verses.original: δὲ χωρὶς πάσης ἀντιλογίας τὸ ἔλαττον εὐλογεῖται ὑπὸ τοῦ κρείττονος
verses.transliteration: de chōris pasēs antilogias to elatton eulogeitai hypo tou kreittonos
verses.literal: And vvv vvv indisputably the lesser is blessed by the greater

verses.original: Καὶ μὲν ὧδε ἀποθνῄσκοντες ἄνθρωποι λαμβάνουσιν δεκάτας δὲ ἐκεῖ μαρτυρούμενος ὅτι ζῇ
verses.transliteration: Kai men hōde apothnēskontes anthrōpoi lambanousin dekatas de ekei martyroumenos hoti zē
verses.literal: vvv vvv In the case [of the Levites] mortal men collect the tenth but in the case [of Melchizedek] it is affirmed that he lives on

verses.original: καὶ ὡς ἔπος εἰπεῖν Λευὶ καὶ ὁ λαμβάνων δεκάτας δεδεκάτωται δι’ Ἀβραὰμ
verses.transliteration: kai hōs epos eipein Leui kai ho lambanōn dekatas dedekatōtai di’ Abraam
verses.literal: And so vvv to speak Levi - who collects [the] tenth paid [the] tenth through Abraham

verses.original: γὰρ ὅτε Μελχισέδεκ συνήντησεν αὐτῷ ἦν ἔτι ἐν τῇ ὀσφύϊ τοῦ πατρὸς
verses.transliteration: gar hote Melchisedek synēntēsen autō ēn eti en tē osphui tou patros
verses.literal: For when Melchizedek met Abraham [Levi] was still in the loin of [his] ancestor

verses.original: οὖν Εἰ τελείωσις ἦν μὲν διὰ τῆς Λευιτικῆς ἱερωσύνης γὰρ ἐπ’ αὐτῆς ὁ λαὸς νενομοθέτηται τίς ἔτι χρεία ἕτερον ἱερέα ἀνίστασθαι λέγεσθαι κατὰ τὴν τάξιν Μελχισέδεκ καὶ οὐ κατὰ τὴν τάξιν Ἀαρὼν
verses.transliteration: oun Ei teleiōsis ēn men dia tēs Leuitikēs hierōsynēs gar ep’ autēs ho laos nenomothetētai tis eti chreia heteron hierea anistasthai legesthai kata tēn taxin Melchisedek kai ou kata tēn taxin Aarōn
verses.literal: Now if perfection could have been attained - through the Levitical priesthood ( for on this basis the people received [the] law why [was there] still need [for] another priest to appear [one] in the order of Melchizedek and not in the order of Aaron

verses.original: γὰρ τῆς ἱερωσύνης μετατιθεμένης νόμου ἐξ ἀνάγκης μετάθεσις γίνεται καὶ
verses.transliteration: gar tēs hierōsynēs metatithemenēs nomou ex anankēs metathesis ginetai kai
verses.literal: For [when] the priesthood is changed [the] law vvv must be changed . . . as well

verses.original: γὰρ Ἐφ’ ὃν ταῦτα λέγεται μετέσχηκεν ἑτέρας φυλῆς ἀφ’ ἧς οὐδεὶς προσέσχηκεν τῷ θυσιαστηρίῳ
verses.transliteration: gar Eph’ hon tauta legetai meteschēken heteras phylēs aph’ hēs oudeis proseschēken tō thysiastēriō
verses.literal: - [He] of whom these things are said belonged to a different tribe from which no one has ever served at the altar

verses.original: γὰρ πρόδηλον ὅτι ἡμῶν ὁ Κύριος ἀνατέταλκεν ἐξ Ἰούδα φυλὴν εἰς ἣν Μωϋσῆς ἐλάλησεν οὐδὲν περὶ ἱερέων
verses.transliteration: gar prodēlon hoti hēmōn ho Kyrios anatetalken ex Iouda phylēn eis hēn Mōusēs elalēsen ouden peri hiereōn
verses.literal: For [it is] clear that our - Lord descended from Judah a tribe as to which Moses said nothing about priests

verses.original: Καὶ ἐστιν ἔτι περισσότερον κατάδηλόν εἰ ἕτερος ἱερεὺς κατὰ τὴν ὁμοιότητα Μελχισέδεκ ἀνίσταται
verses.transliteration: Kai estin eti perissoteron katadēlon ei heteros hiereus kata tēn homoiotēta Melchisedek anistatai
verses.literal: And [ this point ] is even more clear if another priest - - like Melchizedek appears

verses.original: ὃς γέγονεν οὐ κατὰ νόμον ἐντολῆς σαρκίνης ἀλλὰ κατὰ δύναμιν ἀκαταλύτου ζωῆς
verses.transliteration: hos gegonen ou kata nomon entolēs sarkinēs alla kata dynamin akatalytou zōēs
verses.literal: one who has become [a priest] not by a law of succession . . . but by [the] power of an indestructible life

verses.original: γὰρ μαρτυρεῖται ὅτι Σὺ ἱερεὺς εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα κατὰ τὴν τάξιν Μελχισέδεκ
verses.transliteration: gar martyreitai hoti Sy hiereus eis ton aiōna kata tēn taxin Melchisedek
verses.literal: For it is testified - You [are] a priest vvv vvv forever in the order of Melchizedek

verses.original: μὲν γὰρ προαγούσης ἐντολῆς γίνεται Ἀθέτησις διὰ αὐτῆς τὸ ἀσθενὲς καὶ ἀνωφελές
verses.transliteration: men gar proagousēs entolēs ginetai Athetēsis dia autēs to asthenes kai anōpheles
verses.literal: So . . . the former commandment is set aside because it [was] - weak and useless

verses.original: γὰρ ὁ νόμος ἐτελείωσεν οὐδὲν δὲ κρείττονος ἐλπίδος ἐπεισαγωγὴ δι’ ἧς ἐγγίζομεν τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: gar ho nomos eteleiōsen ouden de kreittonos elpidos epeisagōgē di’ hēs engizomen tō Theō
verses.literal: ( for the law made nothing perfect . . . and a better hope [is] introduced by which we draw near - to God

verses.original: Καὶ καθ’ οὐ ὅσον χωρὶς ὁρκωμοσίας γὰρ εἰσὶν οἱ μὲν γεγονότες ἱερεῖς χωρὶς ὁρκωμοσίας
verses.transliteration: Kai kath’ ou hoson chōris horkōmosias gar eisin hoi men gegonotes hiereis chōris horkōmosias
verses.literal: And . . . none of this [happened] without an oath For - [others] - became priests without an oath

verses.original: δὲ ὁ μετὰ ὁρκωμοσίας διὰ τοῦ λέγοντος πρὸς αὐτόν Κύριος Ὤμοσεν καὶ οὐ μεταμεληθήσεται Σὺ ἱερεὺς εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα
verses.transliteration: de ho meta horkōmosias dia tou legontos pros auton Kyrios Ōmosen kai ou metamelēthēsetai Sy hiereus eis ton aiōna
verses.literal: but [Jesus became a priest] with an oath by the [One who] said to Him [The] Lord has sworn and vvv will not change His mind You [are] a priest vvv vvv forever

verses.original: Κατὰ τοσοῦτο καὶ Ἰησοῦς γέγονεν ἔγγυος κρείττονος διαθήκης
verses.transliteration: Kata tosouto kai Iēsous gegonen engyos kreittonos diathēkēs
verses.literal: Because of this [oath] Jesus has become [the] guarantee of a better covenant

verses.original: Καὶ μὲν εἰσιν γεγονότες πλείονές οἱ ἱερεῖς διὰ τὸ θανάτῳ κωλύεσθαι παραμένειν
verses.transliteration: Kai men eisin gegonotes pleiones hoi hiereis dia to thanatō kōlyesthai paramenein
verses.literal: Now . . . there have been many [other] priests since - death prevented them from continuing [in office]

verses.original: δὲ ὁ διὰ αὐτὸν τὸ μένειν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἔχει τὴν ἀπαράβατον ἱερωσύνην
verses.transliteration: de ho dia auton to menein eis ton aiōna echei tēn aparabaton hierōsynēn
verses.literal: But - because [Jesus] - lives vvv vvv forever He has - a permanent priesthood

verses.original: ὅθεν καὶ δύναται σῴζειν εἰς τὸ παντελὲς τοὺς προσερχομένους τῷ Θεῷ δι’ αὐτοῦ πάντοτε ζῶν εἰς τὸ ἐντυγχάνειν ὑπὲρ αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: hothen kai dynatai sōzein eis to panteles tous proserchomenous tō Theō di’ autou pantote zōn eis to entynchanein hyper autōn
verses.literal: Therefore - He is able to save vvv vvv completely those who draw near - to God through Him [since He] always lives - - to intercede for them

verses.original: Τοιοῦτος ἀρχιερεύς γὰρ καὶ ἔπρεπεν ἡμῖν ὅσιος ἄκακος ἀμίαντος κεχωρισμένος ἀπὸ τῶν ἁμαρτωλῶν καὶ γενόμενος ὑψηλότερος τῶν οὐρανῶν
verses.transliteration: Toioutos archiereus gar kai eprepen hēmin hosios akakos amiantos kechōrismenos apo tōn hamartōlōn kai genomenos hypsēloteros tōn ouranōn
verses.literal: Such a high priest truly - befits us [One who is] holy innocent undefiled set apart from - sinners and exalted above the heavens

verses.original: ὥσπερ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς ὃς ἔχει οὐκ ἀνάγκην ἀναφέρειν καθ’ ἡμέραν θυσίας πρότερον ὑπὲρ τῶν ἰδίων ἁμαρτιῶν ἔπειτα τῶν τοῦ λαοῦ γὰρ ἐποίησεν τοῦτο ἐφάπαξ ἀνενέγκας ἑαυτὸν
verses.transliteration: hōsper hoi archiereis hos echei ouk anankēn anapherein kath’ hēmeran thysias proteron hyper tōn idiōn hamartiōn epeita tōn tou laou gar epoiēsen touto ephapax anenenkas heauton
verses.literal: [Unlike] the [other] high priests [He] does not need to offer vvv daily sacrifices first for [His] own sins and then for [the sins] of the people - He [sacrificed for sin] . . . once for all when He offered up Himself

verses.original: γὰρ ὁ νόμος καθίστησιν ἀρχιερεῖς ἀνθρώπους ἔχοντας ἀσθένειαν δὲ τῆς ὁρκωμοσίας τῆς μετὰ τὸν νόμον ὁ λόγος Υἱόν τετελειωμένον εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα
verses.transliteration: gar ho nomos kathistēsin archiereis anthrōpous echontas astheneian de tēs horkōmosias tēs meta ton nomon ho logos Huion teteleiōmenon eis ton aiōna
verses.literal: For the law appoints as high priests men who are weak but the oath which [came] after the law - [appointed] [the] Son who has been made perfect vvv vvv forever
